spans.s: etá, see etád and cf. 499b with 497.

éta, a. rushing; darting; as m. deer. [√i,
1176c.]

etat-samīpa, n. presence of this one.
[1264.]

etád [499b], pron. this here, prop, referring
to something near the speaker (e. g. 18^8, 19^12,
51^19); this; refers almost always to what
precedes (e. g. 6^9, 19^3, 51^18, 68^5), has just
happened (e. g. 20^11, 2512, 13), or has just
been mentioned (e. g. 7^5, 25^18, 28^11), as being
nearer the speaker; very seldom--28^6, 92^19,
96^5--to what follows; joined with other
pronouns: w. yad, 94^15; w. tad, 45^9, 95^6;
w. aham to be supplied, 52^9. [pron. root
e, 499b: in usage, etád: idám:: ταῦ-
τα: τάδε.]

etad-artham, adv. for this purpose;
therefore. [499b^2, 1302c^4.]

etā-dṛ́ś, a. such; etādṛk, acc. s. n., such
as I have, 82^14. [518.]

etā-dṛ́śa, a. such; et.…yat, such…
that. [518.]

etā́vant, a. thus much, 12^9; etāvān…
yena, so great…that, 21^10. [etá, 517.]
